validity.recommendation: Reclassify PipelineType from 'distribution' to 'transmission' (or flag for human review if the schema treats otvod-to-GRS branches as a third bucket). This otvod terminates AT ГРС «Пажга» and does not itself run through settlements; the actually-distribution segments (межпоселковый network from GRS Pazhga onward to Pazhga/Garyinsky/Garya/Nyuvchim/Shoshka/Graddor villages, and the внутрипоселковый network inside Pazhga village) are separately documented, built by a different operator, and are NOT this row -- they are downstream of the GRS this otvod feeds.
validity.researcher_notes: gem.wiki's own Background text for this row states 'It is a distribution pipeline' with no citation for that classification sentence specifically (it follows the cited gasification-program sentence but isn't itself attributed to source [1] or [2]). Per this batch's structural convention (also applied on sibling otvod rows elsewhere in this batch), a газопровод-отвод feeding a ГРС is upstream/trunk-side infrastructure operated by the regional Gazprom Transgaz subsidiary (here, Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta per komiinform.ru), while the межпоселковый/внутрипоселковый networks past the GRS are the properly distribution-side infrastructure, operated by AO Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Syktyvkar (per mrg11.ru press releases on the Pazhga-area buildout: ~33.9km projected mezhposelkovyi network and a completed 21.4km internal Pazhga-village network -- both explicitly separate objects from 'газопровод-отвод к ГРС «Пажга»'). No source independently confirms 'distribution' for this specific otvod; flagging rather than silently changing PipelineType myself, since GEM may have a documented reason for the current classification that this pass did not surface.

validity.recommendation: Keep P3990 (CS-12-Ust-Vym-Chasovo-Zelenets-Syktyvkar), P3991 (Vylgort-Pazhga, this row) and P3992 (Pazhga-Vizinga) as three SEPARATE rows -- do not merge/combine. They form one sequential corridor (CS-12 near Ust-Vym feeds toward Syktyvkar/Vylgort; Vylgort-area GRS feeds an otvod to GRS Pazhga; GRS Pazhga feeds an otvod on to GRS Vizinga) and each row's gem.wiki page cross-lists the other two as 'Associated infrastructure', which invites the question of whether GEM is artificially splitting one physical line into three rows. Evidence says no: Gazprom's own official Komi 2021-2025 gasification-program listing (gazprommap.ru/komi, archived 2022 and 2023) itemizes 'Газопровод-отвод к ГРС «Пажга» (10,0 тыс. куб м3/час)' and 'Газопровод-отвод к ГРС «Визинга» (7,5 тыс. м3/час)' as two DIFFERENT numbered program line items (point-12 and point-14 in the page's own internal point list) with two DIFFERENT capacities, each independently matching GEM's own recorded Capacity for P3991 (0.24 mill.Sm3/day = 10.0 thou m3/h) and P3992 (0.18 mill.Sm3/day = 7.5 thou m3/h) respectively. P3990 (CS-12 to Syktyvkar) is a structurally different, larger-capacity object (0.464 bcm/year per gem.wiki, roughly an order of magnitude larger than either otvod) feeding the corridor further upstream, not one of the two Pazhga/Vizinga otvod line items at all. This is a textbook case of GEM correctly following the batch-wide convention of one row per otvod-to-GRS pair along a shared corridor, not a duplicate/split-entity problem.
validity.researcher_notes: Corroboration: the 10.0 thou m3/h (Pazhga) and 7.5 thou m3/h (Vizinga) figures were read directly off the same archived gazprommap.ru/komi page in the same pass that sourced P3991's own Capacity fill, so this is the SAME single-origin document as that fill, not a second independent source -- noted as a caveat ('confirmed (caveat)' rather than a stronger verdict). No document was found that discusses the CS-12/Vylgort-Pazhga/Pazhga-Vizinga trio explicitly as a single named mega-project or single construction contract; each is tracked as its own numbered item in Gazprom's own regional program list. cross_row_leads filed pointing P3992 to this same corroborating capacity figure (7.5 thou m3/h) for its own Capacity [ref].
